final: WITH track_rates AS (SELECT t.MediaTypeId, CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds as byte_rate FROM Track t WHERE t.MediaTypeId IS NOT NULL AND t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Bytes > 0 AND t.Milliseconds > 0), media_type_rates AS (SELECT tr.MediaTypeId, AVG(tr.byte_rate) as media_type_rate FROM track_rates tr GROUP BY tr.MediaTypeId), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(media_type_rate) as avg_rate FROM media_type_rates) SELECT mt.Name, mtr.media_type_rate as rate, mtr.media_type_rate - oa.avg_rate as above_average FROM media_type_rates mtr JOIN MediaType mt ON mtr.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE mtr.media_type_rate > oa.avg_rate ORDER BY mtr.media_type_rate DESC
